overview.Module Title: Introduction to Xi Jinping’s Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era

sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module aims to guide students to comprehensively grasp Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era. Through systematic study of its basic content, theoretical system, contemporary value, and historical significance, students will better understand the essence of socialism with Chinese characteristics. This knowledge will help students master the latest theoretical innovations of the Communist Party of China, enhance their theoretical literacy, and understand practical principles, preparing them to actively participate in the great historical process of building socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new era. 《习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想概论》旨在指导学生从整体上把握习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想，系统学习这一思想的基本内容、理论体系、时代价值与历史意义，更好把握中国特色社会主义的理论精髓与实践要义，有助于学生掌握党的最新理论创新成果，提升理论素养，把握实践规律自觉投身到建设新时代中国特色社会主义的伟大历史进程中去。
sections.Learning outcomes: A Clarify the scientific connotation and spiritual essence of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era. 旨在贯彻党的教育方针，培养学生的政治认同、职业精神、法治意识、健全人格、公共参与等核心素养。 B Explain clearly the significant advantages of the socialist system with Chinese characteristics and the national governance system. 使学生能够精准表述习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想的核心要义和基本内容。
sections.Method of teaching and learning: This optional module for Master’s student, delivered online via MOOC platform, is one of Chinese Ideological and Political Theory Modules required by MoE and consists of high-quality recorded lectures produced by faculty members of Fudan University. It is designed to accommodate diverse learning needs and flexible study schedules. 1. Online study time (40%) is about 10 hours. 2. Online quiz (60%) after lectures will be carried out to evaluate students’ progress and achievement of the learning outcomes. Students will have 2 opportunities to take the quiz, and the higher score will be used for grading. No resits. CCT402 是一门面向研究生、由教育部规定的必选选修课程之一（另一门选修课为CCT407，由学生自行选择其中一门进行学习），通过线上 MOOC 平台开设，是由复旦大学马克思主义学院教师录制的精品在线课程。 学生需在一学期内完成本课程的全部学习内容，包括： 1.观看并学习全部线上课程视频（总时长约 10 小时，占课程总成绩的 40%，根据完成比例计分）； 2.完成线上测验Quiz（占课程总成绩的 60%）作为期末考试，系统提供两次作答机会，取最高成绩计入总评，以此检验学习效果。 本课程旨在为研究生系统提供习近平中国特色社会主义思想方面的知识与理解，课程形式灵活，适用于不同学习需求与时间安排的学生。
